paragraphs: Lost Returns sells software for lost property management, covering the tracking, recovery and return of items to the people who lost them. The homepage describes the buyers as clients from all industries and states that the software is paired with integrated logistics.

Reported lost items are matched automatically against a client's found item inventory, work the site calls AI inventory matching. Shipping is built in through integrations with UPS, FedEx, and USPS, so teams can send found items back to their owners. Other features listed are automated updates for owners, safeguards for personal data, and connection to systems a client already runs.
The footer gives the company as Lost Returns, Inc., with a corporate office in London, United Kingdom.

quote.text: Redefining how businesses efficiently handle lost property , one item at a time.
